item.title: Between 2015 and 2025, at least 15 children in an Idaho fait…
item.author: ProPublica (@propublica.org)
item.description:
Between 2015 and 2025, at least 15 children in an Idaho faith-healing sect died of treatable conditions.

State law allows that to happen: Parents who say their faith prohibits giving their children lifesaving medical care can’t be prosecuted.
